Exceptional P¹ corrections yield traces on K3 H²; Newton identities from twelve sums, rank22 and reciprocal functional equation uniquely recover the cyclotomic polynomial. Finite counts plus this global cohomological bridge, not extrapolation, establish every extension. Independent checks support the exact arithmetic and the proof uses standard K3 facts for the unrestricted cohomological conclusion.
